title_zh: 选定观狼平台并确认不离开步道

scenario.label_zh: 确认观察狼的位置和不追逐野生动物的边界
scenario.goal_zh: 问清狼的观察位置，接受留在平台并遵守野生动物观察边界

context_zh: 自然保护区游客向工作人员询问观察安排。
author: author-phase09-c

sentences.speaker: Theo
sentences.text: Someone said a wolf was seen near the ridge. Can I walk up there?

sentences.speaker: Amina
sentences.text: The ridge path is closed today. The observation platform is open, but a sighting isn't guaranteed.

sentences.speaker: Theo
sentences.text: Could I follow the animal if it moves away from the platform?

sentences.speaker: Amina
sentences.text: No. Wherever you see wildlife in this reserve, please stay on the marked paths and give it space.

sentences.speaker: Theo
sentences.text: Understood. I'll use the platform and watch from there.

sentences.speaker: Amina
sentences.text: It's along the yellow path, on your left. The signs will take you straight to it.
